openPullRequests.title: Extend Zotero research-material browsing and reconcile recent work [skip ci]
openPullRequests.body:
## Why

The Zotero reference workspace already supports searching, tags, citations and stored source details. It needs an explicit way to inspect the research notes and attachment metadata belonging to a connected reference while preserving the user's search and document state.

## Changes

- Add paginated direct-child note and attachment reads with exact parent/library validation and desktop database provenance.
- Add **Library → Reference details → Notes and attachments…**, with inert plain-text note previews, note copying, attachment detail copying, explicit paging/retry/reload, and stale-connection guards.
- Preserve selected references, unfinished search/tag input, read-only document state and undo history.
- Reconcile the captured recent main, PPTX, VBA string-conformance and Mail attachment heads with original ancestry retained. Resolve overlapping rendering repairs and preserve both branches' regression coverage.

## Local validation

Final combined-source validation is in progress at `0aac0e0aa5610d6e4dc9427ffa13ebf14a8fcec8` across 134 disjoint files. The complete Zotero engine cohort has passed 642 tests, and all 48 changed Dart targets pass strict analysis and formatting. The final report and accepted raw receipts will be committed before merging.

GitHub Actions, workflow runs, checks and commit-status endpoints are neither queried nor awaited. Incremental source checkpoints are saved on this retained branch. Validation covers local model/controller/widget, serializer, CLI and controlled-transport behavior; no new live Zotero/account or installed Office interoperability acceptance is claimed.

openPullRequests.title: Extend VBA string conformance and reconcile current Office work [skip ci]
openPullRequests.body:
## Why

Continue the next milestone after the dynamic-array VBA increment with precise, bounded string semantics and reusable conformance evidence. Preserve current Office integration work and concurrent main history.

## Changes

- Add `Len`, `Left$`, `Right$`, and `Mid$` with strict types, UTF-16 indexing, one-based starts, optional Mid length, and shared copy-work budgets.
- Reject isolated surrogates at native spreadsheet write boundaries before returning a publishable plan; internal halves and valid recombination remain supported.
- Add a versioned provenance-aware conformance corpus, the same-corpus VM/JavaScript runner, and a complete example exercised through native transactions, MCP, and actual CLI processes.
- Retain incoming PPTX ancestry and reconcile decoration, text, arrow, font fallback, and connector behavior while preserving current main's DOCX/spaCy work.

## Local qualification

This draft preserves incremental remote checkpoints while final combined local gates finish. The string corpus currently has 69 cases; its VM/JavaScript receipts match byte-for-byte, and the focused compiler and conformance/schema suites pass. Connector persistence and combined engine/editor regressions are still being finalized. Exact final results and source bindings will replace this draft status before merge.

GitHub Actions are not queried or awaited for this task. Source changes are qualified locally with repository-pinned Flutter/Dart. This remains a bounded source-to-plan VBA dialect; it does not claim execution against an installed Microsoft Office host.

openPullRequests.title: Add bounded mail attachments and reconcile current Office work
openPullRequests.body:
## Why
Studio Mail could address multiple recipients and retain uncertain drafts, but users could not attach files. This continuation adds that sending foundation toward Office document-to-mail workflows.

## Changes
- Immutable outgoing attachments: up to 10 files and 10 MiB combined, exact binary snapshots, Unicode filenames, and zero-byte files.
- Composer controls for selecting/removing files and showing limits, with bounded reads, cancellation, and all-or-none selection.
- Shared ASCII-safe multipart MIME for SMTP, EWS, Gmail, and Microsoft 365, retaining explicit-envelope Bcc handling and acknowledged uncertain retries.
- Correct quoted-printable terminal whitespace and Unicode wrapping.
- Reconcile current fork work and preserve slide/PDF fixes; incoming VBA and further concurrent branches are being reconciled before final qualification.

## Validation
Local qualification is in progress on pinned Flutter 3.47.8 / Dart 3.13.7 with the actual locked dependency graph. Complete mail core/MIME/store/transport suites and focused attachment, provider-host, and slide/PDF checks have passed. Exact final-source receipts and limits will be attached before merge.

GitHub Actions are not awaited or used as an acceptance gate, as requested. This remains foreground/session-only sending; live provider delivery, durable drafts/outbox, and current-document/VBA mail commands remain future work.
